title: ElevenLabs Agent Conversation Flow: Turn-Taking and Interruptions
desc:
Five settings decide how an ElevenLabs voice agent takes turns: max conversation duration, take turn after silence, soft timeout, interruptions and turn eagerness. This episode explains what each one does, where it lives in the dashboard, the config field behind it, and the documented recommended setups for customer service, information collection, legal disclaimers and EdTech. It also covers the LLM settings that affect pacing: reasoning and backup LLMs.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
